data.body: Verified resolved: merge-to-main-pr.sh has _phase_poll (line 822) that polls CI checks + merge state with configurable timeout (merge.pr_max_wait_seconds, default 3600s); explicit required-check-failure detection at line 877 triggers _phase_remediate autonomous fix loop with tier/global retry ceilings (line 1024+). Indefinite-hang symptom no longer reproducible.
